jobs.description: Platform & Features. jobs.description: CTV Monetization - Where every ad earns more CTV Monetization With our all-in-one solution, you can access the biggest advertisers in the world, maximize fill rates, and leverage proprietary first-party data with plug-&-play implementation. WhizzCo delivers seamless monetization across every platform and device Our Services Fast & Reliable Payments First-Party Data Outstanding Support Streamlined Analytics What is CTV? TVs are the “idiot box” no longer: nowadays, so-called “smart TVs” are fully connected devices, straddling the divide between television and the Web. Connected TVs, streaming media players like Roku and Apple TV, and other internet-connected devices have access to a wide array of online streaming content and services. Through CTV, customers access a range of services, all from the comfort of their own home – and unlike the linear TV ads of the old days, you have better and more granular access to those customers than ever before possible. We Are Google Certified Publishing Partners Be confident in the partner you work with. WhizzCo has been a Google Certified Publisher Partner since 2019, and brings years of monetization experience working within the Google ad ecosystem. We’ve carried that trust and expertise over to all our video offerings. Turbocharge Your Monetization WhizzCo gives you access to Premium Advertisers, like Google Ad Exchange, Unruly, Pubmatic and more. Our specialty algorithms and auction-decisioning engine ensures every impression is sold at the highest possible CPM, and enables audience-based campaigns to scale with greater efficiency than our competitors. You choose your ideal audience; ads are 100% viewable and cannot be skipped. OTT Monetization With the streaming video market continuing to grow year over year, forging connections with over-the-top (OTT) streaming platforms and CTV manufacturers is an increasingly-important opportunity for the ad tech industry. To maximize your revenue, you need a partner who understands the challenges of operating within this space, and can ensure that you’re getting the most bang for your buck. Plug-and-Play Get Started ASAP It’s easy: review your monetization needs and give us your list of apps and platforms. jobs.title: About Us
jobs.description: About WhizzCo - Our Mission and Team About Us/ Why Whizzco/ Our Mission/ Building a fair content recommendation ecosystem, one algorithm at a time Before WhizzCo, native content advertising was a hermetically-sealed market. Publishers could only work with one content recommendation (CR) vendor at a time – often with long-term exclusivity contracts. Stuck in the early 2000s of digital advertising , there were no programmatic (or any other) auctions. No transparency. And none of the critical data needed for effective decision making. WhizzCo data demonstrates that without competition for placements, high-traffic publishers left over $1B/year in ad revenue on the table in 2021. Leveling the playing field, the vendor-neutral WhizzCo Native Ads Optimization Platform for Publishers enables, for the first time, fair and transparent competition in the native content recommendation space. 5B+ Monthly add requests 100s Domains 37.7% Average CPM increase Don’t take our word for it…read our reviews! “Whizzco’s platform allowed us to create a competitive ecosystem, which has enabled tighter customization, competition and editorial guideline control, yielding a 75% increase in content recommendation CPM.” Ryan Nathanson “Their intuitive platform makes monetizing our content a piece of cake” Ivan Petricevic “WhizzCo has offered a unique solution for diversifying the user experience for content recommendation. The team is a pleasure to work with and performance is strong.” Valerie Weldon Our roots Looking to monetize a high-traffic domain with native content ads, brothers Alon and Guy Rosenthal understood that they were not earning as much as they should. As serial adtech entrepreneurs, they knew well how to optimize every other kind of online ad using programmatic platforms. But content recommendations were just not built that way. They saw that content recommendation advertising needed an urgent shake-up , that it never reached the critical milestone of real-time bidding. So they built their own tool that would leverage machine learning to predict in real-time which vendor would provide the highest bid for their traffic. And it worked. Really well. So well, that they took their platform and expanded it to support all native ad vendors and qualifying high-traffic publishers. Today WhizzCo’s multi-vendor platform serves hundreds of domains across the world ensuring publishers earn the highest, most appropriate bids for their traffic, every time. jobs.title: Vendor Guide
jobs.description: Vendor Guide - WhizzCo Know your vendor native ad vendor guide If you had to put together the all-stars team of native ad vendors - who would make the cut and why? Below is the list of native ad vendors for 2023 Use them wisely, use them all. A-C D-I J-M N-Q R-S T-Z Search by GEO All countries allowed US Algeria Australia Bahrain Canada Denmark Egypt Greece India Indonesia Iraq Japan Jordan Kenya Kuwait Lebanon Morocco Netherlands New Zealand Nigeria Norway Oman Qatar Russia Saudi Arabia South Africa South Korea Spain Sweden Syria Taiwan Tunisia Turkey UAE UK Search by Ad Type Content rec ads Instream video ads Say hi to one of the first content recommendation platforms. Adblade was launched in 2008 and is going strong ever since. The company only works with US traffic. Geos: US India - home to 1 billion potential visitors and Adgebra will help you monetize them. Add them to your vendor mix to serve well-paying ads to Indian visitors. Geos: India AdStyle serves ads to all users. This vendor is known for its aesthetic, clean layout, and its premium advertisers. If you want to avoid unsavory content and stick to brand-name ads - AdStyle is your friend. Geos: All countries allowed Aniview started out as a video player tech company - and added their marketplace later. Their player is used by other vendors, too. Geos: All countries allowed Anyclip offers a wide range of video solutions for publishers for web, mobile, and CTV/OTT platforms. Geos: All countries allowed This vendor has been around for a while as Avantis Video. After merging with Browsi they stopped using a third-party player and developed their own, in-house widget. Geos: All countries allowed CodeFuels fills inventories with search term and intent-based offerings. It works best for verticals strong on search terms (cars, phones, finance, etc). Geos: Australia, Canada, New Zealand, UK, US You might want to work with Colombia if you have visitors from India. Colombia will give you decent returns on this otherwise hard-to-monetize geo. Geos: All countries allowed, India Connatix delivers strong demand for US and Canadian traffic. Their claim to fame is their pool of brand name advertisers and their sleek-looking player. Geos: All countries allowed Do you have premium content and visitors from the Far East? To serve them targeted content, make sure to use Dable. Geos: Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan What used to be Lockerdome is now Decide. Decide works well with news sites, but less so if you are looking for lifestyle or entertainment-themed ads. Geos: US Dianomi is a strong choice for domains specializing in finance and/or business that prefer brand-name advertisers and premium content. Geos: All countries allowed EngageYA focuses on monetizing traffic from Tier 3 geos. The company help you serves ads to audiences from Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and Eastern Europe. Geos: Bahrain, Greece, Kenya, Kuwait, Nigeria, Oman, Qatar, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, UAE Ex.co (you might know them as Playbuzz) started out as an instream quiz solution - and graduated into a full-blown native video solution with strong (partly direct) demand. They also create their own content. Geos: All countries allowed Do you remember PowerInbox? Then you know Jeeng, too. The former acquired the latter and is now serving content ads for Tier-1 audiences. Geos: Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Africa, UK, US Jubna specializes in serving ads for Arabic-speaking visitors from the Middle East and North Africa. Geos: Algeria, Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Morocco, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Tunisia, UAE mGid serves a worldwide audience with a wide range of advertisers. Geos: All countries allowed Minute Media is a real adtech evolution case study. The company started out as a publisher, later created their own video player, and then added their own demand to the mix - and very unique demand, at that. Geos: All countries allowed If you know Newsmax - you know Netizen. Netizen used to be the digital arm of the conservative news site. Netizen has global reach and serves content to visitors from all geos. Geos: All countries allowed A market leader, Outbrain covers all geos and works with a wide range of publishers. Geos: All countries allowed Plista delivers ads to all visitors, but delivers premium content to German-speaking users from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Geos: All countries allowed With a focus on music, gaming, Latin/X, and finance, Primis offers a sleek design, and brand-name advertisers, and original reels for visitors. Geos: All countries allowed RevContent works with worldwide demand with a focus on Tier 1 geos. RevContent is a popular choice among news sites. Geos: All countries allowed Speakol serves targeted ads to Gulf State (and Egyptian) traffic. Consider using them if you have significant traffic from these geos.
